body_lead: Home |Hyderabad |Ktr Calls For Ai Adoption Across Sectors Promises Integration In All Telangana Departments KTR calls for AI adoption across sectors, promises integration in all Telangana departments BRS working president KT Rama Rao called for wider adoption of Artificial Intelligence across sectors, saying Telangana must keep pace with technological change. He said a future BRS government would integrate AI into all departments and expand IT opportunities statewide.
